picks.readme:
# ung220z-tool

光猫（ONT）凭据自查工具箱：**UNG220Z 一键提取**，另含多厂商适配包 `ontkit`
（中兴 / 烽火 / 华为 / 九联），以及固件指纹识别与分家族排障建议。

支持机型与验证状态见 [机型兼容性](#机型兼容性)，其中只有 UNG220Z 经过真机验证。

> ⚠️ 仅用于**你自己的设备**，用于找回自己忘记的管理密码、迁移宽带配置或安全自查。
> 未经授权对他人设备使用属于违法行为，作者不承担任何责任。

## 背景

这类光猫的 Web 管理页基于 `.gch` CGI 框架，登录口令由 TR-069 定期轮换，普通用户拿到的密码往往几天就失效。本工具走 Telnet 通道，直接读取设备配置库，拿到**当下有效**的全部凭据。

## 目录结构

```
ung220z.py          # 主脚本：UNG220Z 一键提权 + 提凭据
ontkit/             # 多厂商适配包
├── cli.py          #   probe / zte / huawei 三个子命令
├── zte_factory.py  #   中兴 webFac 工厂模式（AES-ECB 协议）
├── zte_web.py      #   中兴 .gch 登录、配置解密、凭据提取
├── huawei.py       #   华为 ssmp 登录、开 Telnet（实验性）
└── core.py         #   HTTP 会话 + Telnet 客户端
models/             # 按型号的入口脚本（自动补默认端口）
├── ung853h.py  h3_2.py  g7615.py  hs8145x6.py  b866l1.py
```

## 工作流程

```
用户输入账号密码
   ↓
拼出 http://<ip>/usr=<user>&psw=<pass>&cmd=1&telnet.gch 并打开浏览器（同时脚本直连兜底）
   ↓
Telnet 登录 → root shell
   ↓
sidbg 1 DB decry /userconfig/cfg/db_user_cfg.xml 解密配置
   ↓
提取 Web 账号 / Telnet 口令 / PPPoE / WiFi 密钥 / root 口令
   ↓
打印凭据表 + 落盘日志
```

## 用法

```bash
python3 ung220z.py
```

会依次询问：

```
※ 用户名和密码通常印在光猫【背面贴纸】上（S/N 标签）
  形如「用户名：user   密码：xxxxxxxx」，把光猫翻过来就能看到

① 光猫地址 [192.168.1.1]:
② 用户名 [user]:
③ 密码（输入时不显示）
   密码:
```

也可以全部走命令行：

```bash
python3 ung220z.py -i 192.168.1.1 -u user -p '你的密码'
python3 ung220z.py -i 192.168.1.1 -u user -p '你的密码' --no-browser
```

### 常用参数

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `-i, --ip` | 光猫地址，默认 `192.168.1.1` |
| `-u, --user` | 登录用户名，默认 `user` |
| `-p, --password` | 登录密码，不填则交互输入 |
| `--telnet-user` | Telnet 用户名，默认 `CMCCAdmin` |
| `--telnet-password` | Telnet 口令（部分机型与 Web 口令不同） |
| `--no-browser` | 不调用浏览器，纯 HTTP 请求 |
| `--unlock` | Web 被会话锁占住时重启 httpd 解锁 |
| `--no-release` | 不尝试释放残留 Web 会话 |
| `--telnet-port` | Telnet 端口，默认 23 |
| `--timeout` | 网络超时秒数，默认 8 |

## 输出示例

```
[22:15:00] INFO   会话开始  目标=192.168.1.1  账户=user
[22:15:00] HTTP   已发送给浏览器: http://192.168.1.1/usr=user&psw=***&cmd=1&telnet.gch
[22:15:00] HTTP   telnet.gch → TelnetSet Success!
[22:15:00] PROBE  nc -zv 192.168.1.1 23 → succeeded
[22:15:01] AUTH   Telnet CMCCAdmin / ****** → 登录成功（root）
[22:15:02] SHELL  sidbg 1 DB decry /userconfig/cfg/db_user_cfg.xml → /tmp/debug-decry-cfg
[22:15:03] DATA   DevAuthInfo  CMCCAdmin  / ******  Level=1
[22:15:04] CRACK  MATCH: ******  (/etc/shadow)
```

最后输出凭据汇总表，并写入 `ung220z_<时间戳>.log`。

## 依赖

- Python 3.8+
- 标准库即可，无需 pip 安装
- 设备已开启 Telnet（脚本会自动通过 `telnet.gch` 尝试开启）

## 原理说明

| 环节 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 开 Telnet | `GET /usr=<user>&psw=<pass>&cmd=1&telnet.gch`，返回 `TelnetSet Success!` 即成功 |
| Web 登录 | 密码前端只做 base64，`Frm_Logintoken` 每次响应递增，必须回填实时值 |
| 配置解密 | `sidbg 1 DB decry` 无口令即可解密，得到明文 XML |
| root 口令 | `/etc/shadow` 中为 SHA-256 crypt，工具会用常见出厂口令比对 |

## 多厂商支持（ontkit）

主脚本只针对九联 `.gch` 体系。遇到其他固件时用 `ontkit`：

```bash
# 先识别固件家族
python3 -m ontkit probe -H 192.168.1.1

# 中兴系（G7615 / UNG853H / 吉比特等）：走 webFac 工厂模式开 Telnet
python3 -m ontkit zte -H 192.168.1.1 -p 8080 --mode factory --enable-telnet

# 华为系（HS8145X6 / B866-L1 等）
python3 -m ontkit huawei -H 192.168.1.1
```

按型号直接跑：

```bash
python3 models/g7615.py    -H 192.168.1.1 --mode factory
python3 models/ung853h.py  -H 192.168.1.1 -u user -P '贴纸密码' --extract
```

各型号的验证状态见 [ontkit/README.md](ontkit/README.md)：webFac 协议按公开实现移植并已自测，
其余型号未经真机验证。

## 排障

### `telnet.gch` 返回 404

说明该固件没有这个接口，**不是九联/吉比特的 `.gch` 体系**，本脚本的开启方式不适用。
脚本会打印设备指纹（`Server` 头 + 页面标题）帮助判断。下一步：

```bash
python3 -m ontkit probe -H 192.168.1.1          # 识别固件家族
python3 -m ontkit zte   -H 192.168.1.1 -p 8080  # 中兴系（webFac 工厂模式）
python3 -m ontkit huawei -H 192.168.1.1         # 华为系（ssmp）
```

### `telnet.gch` 成功但 23 端口未监听

- 设备可能在 Web 后台把 Telnet 服务关闭了，只留了开关接口
- 也可能需要几秒才起监听，等一下重试

### Telnet 能连上但登录被拒

Telnet 与 Web 是**两套账号库**。脚本会依次尝试：

1. 你填的 Web 账号（如 `useradmin`）
2. `CMCCAdmin` + 同一口令
3. `--telnet-password` 指定值
4. Web 侧侦察：`manager_aduser_conf_t.gch&IF_INDEX=0` 读管理员行 → 用其口令登录 → `tele_sec_tserver_t.gch` 取 `TS_UPwd`
5. 出厂默认组合

也可以手动在浏览器（已登录状态）打开：

```
http://<光猫IP>/getpage.gch?pid=1002&nextpage=tele_sec_tserver_t.gch
```

PC stats, AI coding sessions, music and touch controls over USB or Wi-Fi.

picks.name: chat-demo
picks.readme:
# chat-demo

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A static chat demo powered by the DeepSeek API. No application backend is required: the browser connects directly to the configured API service.

You can [try the app online](https://deepseek-ai.github.io/chat-demo/) or download the archive from [Releases](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-chat-demo/releases), extract it, and double-click `index.html` to use it locally without installation or a build. Enter your API key in Settings before your first chat.

## Getting started

Install Node.js 22.12+ and pnpm, then run:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/chat-demo.git
cd chat-demo
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

Open http://localhost:8090.

To build the static site:

```sh
pnpm build
```

The output is written to `dist/`. Deploy it to a static web server or open `dist/index.html` directly. Opening the file directly requires browser support for storage on `file://` pages and an API service that permits their cross-origin requests.

## Features

- Multiple conversations with automatic titles, renaming, and deletion; edit prompts, regenerate replies, and switch between message branches.
- Streaming replies, deep thinking, smart search, link reading, and source citations; stop generation or continue eligible replies.
- Upload, paste, or drag and drop attachments; use voice input and read replies aloud. A live audio spectrum appears in the first row of the input area while recording on mobile.
- Markdown, syntax highlighting, KaTeX math, and Mermaid diagrams.
- Simplified Chinese and English, light and dark themes, mobile layouts, location settings, and chat history import and export.

## Data and storage

Your API key and settings are stored in the browser's localStorage. Conversations and original attachments are stored in IndexedDB. Local data is isolated by browser profile and site origin. Sending messages, uploading attachments, and using speech features sends the relevant content to the configured API service.

History import and export in Settings use ZIP archives. After confirmation and successful validation, importing replaces all local conversations and attachments. Exports include conversations and locally available original images, but exclude API keys, settings, and original non-image attachments. See the [history import/export documentation (Chinese)](src/services/chat/history/README.md) for the archive format and preservation details.

Settings → Data → Delete all chats clears all local conversations, original attachments, and unsent drafts after confirmation. It stops ongoing replies and returns to a new chat. Your API key and settings are preserved; files already uploaded to the API service are not deleted.

## Development

| Command       | Description                  |
| ------------- | ---------------------------- |
| `pnpm dev`    | Start the development server |
| `pnpm build`  | Build into `dist/`           |
| `pnpm type`   | Run TypeScript type checks   |
| `pnpm lint`   | Lint with oxlint             |
| `pnpm format` | Format with oxfmt            |

picks.desc: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
picks.readme:
# Astryx An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now:
by people and the agents working alongside them. **Currently in Beta** · Built on [React 19+](https://react.dev) and [StyleX](https://stylexjs.com) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@astryxdesign/core?label=npm&color=cb3837&logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@astryxdesign/core) [![license MIT](https://img.shields.io/github/license/meta/astryx?color=blue)](LICENSE) [![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/meta/astryx/wiki/Contributing) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docs-astryx.atmeta.com-6741d9?logo=readthedocs&logoColor=white)](https://astryx.atmeta.com) [![Storybook](https://img.shields.io/badge/Storybook-live-ff4785?logo=storybook&logoColor=white)](https://astryx.atmeta.com/storybook/) [![Sandbox](https://img.shields.io/badge/Sandbox-playground-A9792B)](https://astryx.atmeta.com/sandbox/) **[Docs](https://astryx.atmeta.com)** · **[Storybook](https://astryx.atmeta.com/storybook/)** · **[Sandbox](https://astryx.atmeta.com/sandbox/)** · **[Contributing](https://github.com/meta/astryx/wiki/Contributing)** · **[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/XnsUcFykEP)**
## Overview Astryx is an open source design system that grew inside Meta over the last eight years, where it became the most-used and largest design system in the company — powering 13,000+ apps and shaped by the engineers, designers, and product teams who depend on it every day. It ships 150+ accessible components, brand-level theming, dark mode, ready-to-ship templates, and a CLI as one cohesive system. You import pre-built CSS and use typed React components — no build plugin, no styling library to adopt — and both people and AI assistants build with the same tooling. **What makes Astryx different:** - **Open internals.** Components are built to be composed at any level, not locked behind a closed top-level API. The building blocks you'd reach for are exported directly, and when you need to go deeper, swizzle ejects a component's full source into your project to own. - **No styling lock-in.** Astryx authors its styles with StyleX, but that's invisible to consumers. Override with `className` using Tailwind, CSS modules, or plain CSS — whatever your project already uses. - **Customize without wrapping.** A theme is a set of CSS custom property overrides, so a designer can make Astryx unmistakably theirs without forking or wrapping component source. - **Built for people and agents.** The API, docs, and CLI are designed together so a person and an AI assistant build the same way, from the same reference. ## Getting Started Astryx requires **React 19** or later (`react` and `react-dom` are peer dependencies of `@astryxdesign/core`). Install Astryx, a theme, and its peer dependencies: ```bash # npm npm install @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex npm install -D @astryxdesign/cli # pnpm pnpm add @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex pnpm add -D @astryxdesign/cli # yarn yarn add @astryxdesign/core @astryxdesign/theme-neutral @stylexjs/stylex yarn add -D @astryxdesign/cli ``` Then finish setup with `init`, once, before you write UI. It asks no questions, prints the getting-started steps (styles, theme), and saves the Astryx guide to `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` so you and your agents build with Astryx instead of guessing: ```bash npx @astryxdesign/cli init # or: pnpm exec astryx init / yarn astryx init ``` You can also install the CLI once for your computer, so `astryx` works in any folder and every coding agent knows Astryx; in a project, it still runs that project's own version: ```bash npm i -g @astryxdesign/cli ``` Project

picks.readme:
# Exact **The all-platform app framework. Agent native. Built for speed. No compromises.** Exact is an **all-platform** framework for building real apps on the web, iOS, macOS, Android, and Linux — with Windows in active development, plus tvOS, watchOS, Android TV, and the terminal. Exact is not a "cross-platform" framework. Cross-platform tools usually trade away each platform's strengths to maintain a lowest common denominator. Exact takes the opposite approach: build something **excellent on every platform on its own terms** — real DOM on the web, real UIKit on iOS, real AppKit on macOS, hardware-accelerated Material 3 rendering with native Android views on Android, and direct GPU/CPU rendering on Linux and Windows. Being **all-platform** is simply the side effect of getting every platform right from one source. Everything in Exact is built around three priorities: 1. **[Agent Native](#1-agent-native)** — Built from the ground up so coding agents can build, run, see, operate, and verify real apps on every platform through one deterministic loop. 2. **[Speed is King](#2-speed-is-king)** — 100 ms cold starts, 100 ms edit-to-present reloads, zero app JavaScript before first pixel, and a ~20 KB web runtime, held to hard budgets. 3. **[No Compromises — Build Exactly What You Want](#3-no-compromises--build-exactly-what-you-want)** — Native platform controls with zero tells when you leave presentation unsaid; full creative control over layout, motion, graphics, shaders, and native platform objects whenever you want it. > [!NOTE] > Exact is pre-1.0 and changes daily. There is no packaged release, API stability guarantee, or backwards-compatibility layer yet — you build from a checkout of this repository.

包一层网页界面，做成给非技术人用的成品
集成进自己的项目，跳过从零写这一段
how: 按 README 装依赖（这一步最容易卡住）
跑一个作者给的示例，确认能出结果
把自己的数据/需求换成示例里的输入
analy.gap: 补 3 个真实场景示例，每个都能直接跑出结果
analy.buyer: 要用这套能力但搞不定环境的人
analy.why: 要用这套能力但搞不定环境的人不是不会做，是懒得为这一步花两三天试错。你把「补 3 个真实场景示例，每个都能直接跑出结果」替他们做完，他们花的钱远少于自己折腾的时间。
analy.self: 接到类似需求直接拿它当底子，省掉搭骨架的两三天；顺手把它当成自己的技术储备，下次报价敢往上抬。
analy.pack: 包一层网页界面，录一段 3 分钟演示，按份卖；买家买的不是代码，是「不用装环境」。落地上就按这条走：做成中文教程 + 成品包，走知识付费。
